summary: Station Road kerb on a bend, half-hour parking and almost no parked cars.

drivers.seclusion: Dealership and a commercial building are 13-20 m away; apartments 18-23 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow kerb on a bend of a through route; no marked parking lane.
drivers.traffic: Busy through road with buses, lane widens at the junction.
drivers.convention: One car at the start only; sign allows 1/2P so it is short-stay.

flags: Main road with no parking: rule-out
Signs: 1/2P parallel parking, not for overnight
sun_shade: Trees on the verge shade the kerb from the east and north.

best_section.where: Station Road east kerb, on the bend below the dealership
